name: Wispr Flow
description: Wispr Flow (maker: Wispr AI) is a San Francisco-based foreign private company with no Indian corporate registration, co-founded by Tanay Kothari and Sahaj Garg. Scaling India go-to-market since Nov 2025.

stock.note: Private; valuation ~$2bn after a $280M Series B (Menlo Ventures-led, Aug 17, 2026); total funding $361M, up from a $700M valuation in Nov 2025.

marketing_spend.derivation: Private, not in PMAR — Tiers 1-2 don't apply. Early-stage AI SaaS companies spend heavily off a small revenue base; on ~$10M ARR, even 30-60% of revenue directed to marketing models to ~$3-6M global spend. India-specific spend is minimal (organic/GTM-seeding as the India+UK expansion is recent) — roughly ₹2-8 crore.

business_updates.headline: $280M Series B at a $2bn valuation, led by Menlo Ventures
Launched proprietary speech model 'Canto' and Wispr Flow Notetaker
India + UK go-to-market expansion; Android app launched since Nov 2025
